units.source_en: But when he saw the might of our formation, he grew so frightened that he hid in the fort without even daring to engage us.”
units.source_zh: 但是看到我们的强大阵容后，害怕得不及交战就躲进了堡垒。”

units.source_en: This mistaken judgment played directly into Nobunaga's surprise attack.
units.source_zh: 这种错误判断正好给信长的奇袭提供了便利。

paragraphs.source_zh: 敌人没有看到信长率领的一千精锐，却清楚地看到兵马进入了善照寺。“信长的确出来了。但是看到我们的强大阵容后，害怕得不及交战就躲进了堡垒。”这种错误判断正好给信长的奇袭提供了便利。

paragraphs.source_en: In the blink of an eye, Nobunaga had passed around the low hill north of Kirihara and was heading straight for Kosaka. From there he meant to cross Mount Taishigane, strike the Imagawa army's right wing, and decide the battle once and for all. The morale of Nobunaga's army was soaring. Sweat, pain, and exhaustion had long been forgotten; confidence in certain victory inspired the thousand elite horsemen.

units.source_en: In the blink of an eye, Nobunaga had passed around the low hill north of Kirihara and was heading straight for Kosaka.
units.source_zh: 转眼间，信长已经绕过桐原北方的小山冈，直奔小坂。

units.source_en: From there he meant to cross Mount Taishigane, strike the Imagawa army's right wing, and decide the battle once and for all.
units.source_zh: 他要从那里越过太子根山，袭击今川军的右翼，从而一决胜负。

units.source_en: The morale of Nobunaga's army was soaring.
units.source_zh: 信长的军队士气旺盛。

units.source_en: Sweat, pain, and exhaustion had long been forgotten; confidence in certain victory inspired the thousand elite horsemen.
units.source_zh: 汗水、疼痛和疲劳早已抛诸脑后，必胜的信心鼓舞着一千精锐骑兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 转眼间，信长已经绕过桐原北方的小山冈，直奔小坂。他要从那里越过太子根山，袭击今川军的右翼，从而一决胜负。信长的军队士气旺盛。汗水、疼痛和疲劳早已抛诸脑后，必胜的信心鼓舞着一千精锐骑兵。

paragraphs.source_en: At noon, the column reached Mount Taishigane. By then dark clouds blanketed the sky, and a storm was gathering.

units.source_en: At noon, the column reached Mount Taishigane.
units.source_zh: 正午时分，队伍到了太子根山。

units.source_en: By then dark clouds blanketed the sky, and a storm was gathering.
units.source_zh: 这时，天空乌云笼罩，风雨欲来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正午时分，队伍到了太子根山。这时，天空乌云笼罩，风雨欲来。

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga halted his horse on the low hill and ordered his high-spirited elite troops to rest where they stood.

units.source_en: Nobunaga halted his horse on the low hill and ordered his high-spirited elite troops to rest where they stood.
units.source_zh: 信长在小丘上停住了马，命令士气正旺的精锐部队原地休息。

paragraphs.source_zh: 信长在小丘上停住了马，命令士气正旺的精锐部队原地休息。

paragraphs.source_en: From the mountain, everything in the valley below could be seen at a glance, yet the men in the valley remained wholly unaware. If they charged down now, the enemy would unquestionably be thrown into chaos. Nobunaga ordered the men to rest, but did not dismount himself. As he weighed the relative positions of the two sides, he watched both the sky and the valley.

units.source_en: From the mountain, everything in the valley below could be seen at a glance, yet the men in the valley remained wholly unaware.
units.source_zh: 从山上往下看去，谷中的情形一览无余，谷中之人却还一无所知。

units.source_en: If they charged down now, the enemy would unquestionably be thrown into chaos.
units.source_zh: 若趁势冲下去，敌人无疑会乱作一团。

units.source_en: Nobunaga ordered the men to rest, but did not dismount himself.
units.source_zh: 信长命令众人休息，自己却并不下马。

units.source_en: As he weighed the relative positions of the two sides, he watched both the sky and the valley.
units.source_zh: 他一边对比双方形势，一边观察着天空和山谷。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从山上往下看去，谷中的情形一览无余，谷中之人却还一无所知。若趁势冲下去，敌人无疑会乱作一团。信长命令众人休息，自己却并不下马。他一边对比双方形势，一边观察着天空和山谷。

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly a cold wind swept across the summit, and in an instant a thunderstorm poured down like water released through a floodgate. The valley below erupted into turmoil as the soldiers scattered in search of shelter from the rain. Nobunaga stared intently at the confusion below.

units.source_en: Suddenly a cold wind swept across the summit, and in an instant a thunderstorm poured down like water released through a floodgate.
units.source_zh: 突然，一阵冷风吹过山顶，霎时，雷雨如泄闸之水，倾盆而下。

units.source_en: The valley below erupted into turmoil as the soldiers scattered in search of shelter from the rain.
units.source_zh: 下面的山谷中如炸了锅一般，士兵们纷纷找地方避雨。

units.source_en: Nobunaga stared intently at the confusion below.
units.source_zh: 信长紧紧地注视着眼下的慌乱情形。

paragraphs.source_zh: 突然，一阵冷风吹过山顶，霎时，雷雨如泄闸之水，倾盆而下。下面的山谷中如炸了锅一般，士兵们纷纷找地方避雨。信长紧紧地注视着眼下的慌乱情形。

paragraphs.source_en: Lightning tore across the sky, and thunder shook the earth.

units.source_en: Lightning tore across the sky, and thunder shook the earth.
units.source_zh: 闪电划破长空，雷声震撼着大地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 闪电划破长空，雷声震撼着大地。

paragraphs.source_en: The surroundings were suddenly plunged into darkness, as though night had fallen. Thunder rolled amid the raging wind and rain, as though a mighty host were charging in.

units.source_en: The surroundings were suddenly plunged into darkness, as though night had fallen.
units.source_zh: 周围顿时一片黑暗，如同入夜一般。

units.source_en: Thunder rolled amid the raging wind and rain, as though a mighty host were charging in.
units.source_zh: 雷声隆隆，狂风暴雨，有如千军万马而来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 周围顿时一片黑暗，如同入夜一般。雷声隆隆，狂风暴雨，有如千军万马而来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Do not rush! Wait for the perfect moment!” Even Nobunaga's fearsome roar was swallowed by the storm, reaching the men as no more than a faint voice.

units.source_en: “Do not rush! Wait for the perfect moment!”
units.source_zh: “不要急，等待最佳时机！”

units.source_en: Even Nobunaga's fearsome roar was swallowed by the storm, reaching the men as no more than a faint voice.
units.source_zh: 连信长那骇人的怒号也被风雨淹没，人们只听见微弱的声音。

paragraphs.source_zh: “不要急，等待最佳时机！”连信长那骇人的怒号也被风雨淹没，人们只听见微弱的声音。

paragraphs.source_en: In the valley, the soldiers scrambled for refuge in farmhouses or beneath great trees, like hornets from a smashed nest.

units.source_en: In the valley, the soldiers scrambled for refuge in farmhouses or beneath great trees, like hornets from a smashed nest.
units.source_zh: 山谷中，士兵们争相逃往民房中或大树下，简直像捣破的马蜂窝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 山谷中，士兵们争相逃往民房中或大树下，简直像捣破的马蜂窝。

paragraphs.source_en: The troops responsible for the security of Yoshimoto's camp did not abandon their positions, but whenever a violent gust struck, they had to cling desperately to the tents to keep them from blowing away, making a wretched spectacle.

units.source_en: The troops responsible for the security of Yoshimoto's camp did not abandon their positions, but whenever a violent gust struck, they had to cling desperately to the tents to keep them from blowing away, making a wretched spectacle.

units.source_zh: 义元手下负责营地安全的部队虽然没有动弹，但每当狂风吹过，他们为了不让帐篷被风吹跑，不得不拼命拉住，狼狈尽现。

paragraphs.source_zh: 义元手下负责营地安全的部队虽然没有动弹，但每当狂风吹过，他们为了不让帐篷被风吹跑，不得不拼命拉住，狼狈尽现。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time the fury of the wind and rain began to abate, it was already the Hour of the Sheep.

units.source_en: By the time the fury of the wind and rain began to abate, it was already the Hour of the Sheep.
units.source_zh: 当狂风暴雨威势稍减时，已是未时。

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga galloped back and forth among his troops, issuing orders. “Make no sound until we reach Yoshimoto's main force! Go straight for Yoshimoto's head; trample every other soldier underfoot.”

units.source_en: Nobunaga galloped back and forth among his troops, issuing orders. “Make no sound until we reach Yoshimoto's main force!
units.source_zh: 信长在军中来回飞驰，发布命令：“在杀至义元主力之前，不得出声！

units.source_en: Go straight for Yoshimoto's head; trample every other soldier underfoot.”
units.source_zh: 直取义元首级，其他士卒通通踩在脚下。”

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga raised the celebrated blade Hasebe Kunishige high overhead. At the command to attack, the elite troops, who could restrain themselves no longer, swept down like tigers descending a mountain, charging into Dengakukubo and heading straight for Yoshimoto's great palanquin.

paragraphs.source_en: Caught in the sudden assault and wholly unaware of what was happening, the Imagawa army dissolved into chaos. Men careered wildly across the fields in wretched confusion, and cries of anguish rose everywhere.
